svg.title: Tree-likeness of three Austronesian cultural classes, recomputed
svg.desc: Panel a: per-culture delta scores, recomputed from the released cultural distance matrices, for religion, social organisation and subsistence, shown as box plots with the individual cultures and a bar at each class mean; religion has the highest scores and subsistence the lowest. Panel b: the recomputed delta score of each culture against the SplitsTree output released with the paper; the points lie on the line of equality.
